_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil base rate (0/35 windows with ±2+ movement) and unmet confirmation criteria override the bullish analog — HOLD with conviction is the skilled call until the breaker reveals itself.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both see bottom analog DNA but analyst forces a premature LONG while narrative describes compression without committing to timing; the judge sides with the coil statistics over the directional lean
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding rises above 0.015% with stablecoin_growth flipping positive and fear_greed crossing 40
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks below $62k with exchange_netflow spiking above 70 and funding turning negative
